about: Baseline for wire-map-check.js. Every squad / soldier / eng field that more than one source file writes, with each writer's role. A field can gain a writer file only by an edit here, which a reviewer sees; a listed writer that stops writing must be removed (the ratchet only tightens). Roles: owner (the layer AGENTS.md names for the field), layer (a documented sibling layer whose remit includes it), setup (spawn, initial placement or restart), fallback (runs only when the owner is absent), slot (written from a slot the owner declares), body (the soldier body's own mechanics), debt (crosses layers; needs fix). A writer may combine roles with +. fix is a phase of the AI layers polish (phase 2a, 2c, 3a, 5) or unscheduled. why is free text or a key of reasons.

reasons.garrison-setup: Deployment: garrison() rewrites the defender squad inside `if (teleport)`, called once from deploy() at battle start before any AI tick. The runtime call only publishes request and post constraints.
reasons.route-setup: Initial route allocation (assignSquad, from initForce and from ensureAssignments for squads with no route yet) before the Squad Leader executes any mission.
reasons.spawn-stamp: Spawn: stamps a fresh unit when it is created (battle-sim spawnAll at battle start, module 10 for operator reinforcements, module-registry addUnit defaults).
reasons.restart-reset: Restart: BattleSim.restart sweeps every soldier and squad through the module reset hooks.
reasons.nav-invalidate: Invalidates Navigation's cached path by hand after moving a soldier or his destination. Each cache records its goal and world version, so the reader that uses it could reject a stale entry itself.
reasons.resolver-fallback: Only when BattleMovementResolver is absent (isolated unit harness); production loads the resolver before any AI tick.
reasons.engagement-fallback: no-Engagement fallback (fallbackBehavior): only runs when engagement.js failed to load, so a broken deployment still fights.
reasons.squad-status-fallback: Status-only squadStatus: runs only when no squadCommand owner is attached; the Squad Leader replaces it.
